title: AI & Machine Learning Privacy Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your AI privacy risk score. Assess data exposure from ChatGPT, machine learning tools, and AI platforms with actionable protection tips.
description: Evaluate your privacy exposure from AI and machine learning platforms. This calculator assesses your risk based on AI usage patterns, data sharing habits, and privacy settings to help you protect your personal information.

inputs.label: How often do you use AI tools (ChatGPT, Bard, etc.)?
inputs.helpText: More frequent usage increases data collection exposure

inputs.label: Do you use AI tools for work-related tasks?
inputs.helpText: Work data shared with AI can pose business and personal privacy risks

inputs.label: How often do you share personal information with AI?
inputs.helpText: Personal details in AI conversations may be stored and used for training

inputs.label: Have you configured privacy settings on AI platforms?

options.label: Yes, on all platforms I use

inputs.helpText: Privacy settings can limit data collection and conversation storage

inputs.label: Number of different AI platforms you use
inputs.helpText: Each platform has different privacy policies and data practices

inputs.label: Have you opted out of AI training data collection?
inputs.helpText: Opting out prevents your data from being used to train AI models

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall AI privacy risk level (0-100)

formula: const frequencyScores = {never: 0, monthly: 10, weekly: 20, daily: 35, multiple: 50}; const workScores = {never: 0, sometimes: 15, regularly: 25, always: 40}; const personalScores = {never: 0, rarely: 5, sometimes: 15, often: 25, always: 35}; const settingsScores = {all: 0, some: 10, few: 20, none: 30}; const optOutScores = {yes: 0, some: 10, no: 25, unsure: 20}; const platformScore = Math.min(inputs.aiPlatformsUsed * 3, 25); const totalScore = frequencyScores[inputs.aiUsageFrequency] + workScores[inputs.workAiUsage] + personalScores[inputs.personalDataSharing] + settingsScores[inputs.privacySettings] + platformScore + optOutScores[inputs.dataOptOut]; const riskScore = Math.min(Math.round(totalScore), 100); let riskLevel = 'Low Risk'; if (riskScore >= 60) riskLevel = 'High Risk'; else if (riskScore >= 30) riskLevel = 'Moderate Risk'; return {riskScore, riskLevel};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your AI privacy risk based on usage frequency, data sharing patterns, privacy settings configuration, and opt-out status. Higher scores indicate greater exposure to data collection, storage, and potential misuse by AI platforms.
tips: Review and enable privacy settings on all AI platforms you use - many default to maximum data collection
Avoid sharing sensitive personal, financial, or work information in AI conversations
Use a privacy-focused browser when accessing AI tools to limit tracking and data correlation
Regularly opt out of AI training data collection where platforms offer this option
Consider using privacy-focused AI alternatives that don't store conversation history

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy practices. Continue monitoring AI platform policies and maintain current privacy settings.

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some privacy exposure. Review settings on AI platforms and reduce sharing of personal information.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure. Immediate action needed to configure privacy settings and limit data sharing.
